column1: # attribution_rules.tsv: frozen rule table for harness/attribution.py (FULL_PREREG section 11; STAGE2 T5.4).
# Written 2026-11-11 by pkg:ATTRIB_HARM before any study data existed. drafted_by: pkg:ATTRIB_HARM; status: prepared.
# ROW ORDER = FROZEN PRIORITY (first matching row gives the primary label). Tiers: A idioms specific to one catalogue row; B cast/type-probe
# idioms tied to one family; C generic API calls that need a context and co-occur most; L LOUD_CONTEXT rows (moved to the front when the
# target run is LOUD). Within a tier: catalogue row order, except C04 (moved before C01/C02; see its rationale). use: all = line, warning and
# static steps; line = not used by the static step (too common); refine = only refines an option-flag family (step 1).
# Regexes: Python re, case-sensitive; line/static on comment-stripped source lines; context on the comment-stripped program; warn on
# 2.3.3 (E0a) pandas-warning messages; exc on "<exc_type>: <exc_msg>" of a LOUD target. Columns are TAB-separated; empty = not used.
